question: Which of the following is processed by the modern computers?
solution:
The correct answer is** option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Modern computers process binary numbers**, which consist of only two digits (0 and 1).
 
• All other types of numbers, such as decimal, hexadecimal, and strings, are converted to binary before being processed by the computer.
 
• **Binary numbers** are used by computers because they can be easily represented by the on/off switches of transistors, which are the building blocks of modern processors.
 
• **Binary numbers** are also used because they are easy to manipulate using logical operations, such as AND, OR, and NOT.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decimal numbers:** Are commonly used by humans, but they require more storage space and processing power to handle than binary numbers.
 
• **Digits and strings: **Are processed by computers, but they are first converted to binary before being processed.
 
• **Hexadecimal numbers:** Aare also converted to binary before being processed, as they are not a native format for computers.
